tools.name: get_charter_quote_instructions
tools.description: Get the page where a quote request starts (search the trip, then send the request form) and the details it needs. Does not submit a request.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_charter_quote_instructions" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get the request form and details needed for a verified private coach quote. Does not submit a request." → after: "Get the page where a quote request starts (search the trip, then send the request form) and the details it needs. Does not submit a request."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
